title: Divisorial sections factor locally in an fs chart
statement: Let $(Y,T)$ be a divisorial fine saturated log regular pair [def-trf-log-regular-pair], with $Y$ locally Noetherian [pqf-def-locnoeth], and write $M_Y=\mathcal O_Y\cap j_*\mathcal O_{Y\setminus T}^{\times}$ for its log structure, where $j:Y\setminus T\hookrightarrow Y$. Let $V\to Y$ be etale [def-weil-etale-morphism], let $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to V$ be a geometric point [def-weil-geometric-point], and let $h_1,\ldots,h_r\in\Gamma(V,\mathcal O_V)$ be a finite list, allowing $r=0$, each invertible on $V\times_Y(Y\setminus T)$ [def-pc-base-change]. There is a pointed etale neighbourhood $V'\to V$ of $\bar y$ and a chart $c:P\to M_Y|_{V'}$ by a fine saturated commutative monoid $P$ such that for every $1\leq i\leq r$ there are $a_i\in P$ and $\varepsilon_i\in\Gamma(V',\mathcal O_{V'})^\times$ with $h_i|_{V'}=\varepsilon_i\alpha(a_i)$, where $\alpha:P\to\Gamma(V',\mathcal O_{V'})$ is the structure map of $c$. A pointed neighbourhood includes a lift $\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to V'$ of the prescribed geometric point; a chart has the stalk pushout meaning in [def-trf-log-regular-pair].

source.place: Exposé VI §§1.1 and 1.4 (printed p. 69) and Proposition 1.9 proof (printed p. 71), h = epsilon a; finite-list form by simultaneous pointed etale refinement.

proof.text: By the sectionwise definition of the divisorial log structure in [def-trf-log-regular-pair], each $h_i$ is a section of $M_Y$ on the etale object $V$: it is regular there and invertible on $V\times_Y(Y\setminus T)$. In particular its germ belongs to $M_{Y,\bar y}$.

source.place: Exposé VI 1.4, printed p. 69; Proposition 1.9 proof, printed p. 71, membership of h in the divisorial log structure.

proof.text: The fine saturated condition in [def-trf-log-regular-pair] supplies a jointly surjective family of etale maps $U_j\to Y$ with charts $c_j:P_j\to M_Y|_{U_j}$ by fine saturated commutative monoids $P_j$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-covering-base-change] the projections $V\times_YU_j\to V$ are etale and jointly surjective. Apply [lem-weil-pbc-etale-cover-geometric-point-lift] to this family and the prescribed $\bar y:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to V$: it gives some $j$, $W=V\times_YU_j$ and a lift $\bar w:\operatorname{Spec}\Omega\to W$ of $\bar y$ with the same $\Omega$. By [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation](2), $W\to Y$ is etale. Put $A=\mathcal O_{Y,\bar y}$, where $\bar y$ is also viewed over $Y$. Let $P=P_j$ and let $c:P\to M_Y|_W$ be the restriction of $c_j$ along the $Y$-morphism $W\to U_j$. It is a chart: a geometric point of $W$ and its image in $U_j$ lie over one geometric point of $Y$, and the restriction-stalk clause of [lem-trf-finite-monoid-stalk-data-spreading], applied to the sheaves $M_Y$ and $\mathcal O_Y$ and to both pointed neighbourhoods, identifies both stalks with those over $Y$ compatibly with the chart sections, so the pushout condition of $c_j$ is the pushout condition of $c$. The same clause identifies the stalks at $\bar w$ with $M_{Y,\bar y}$ and $A$.

source.place: Exposé VI 1.1, printed p. 69 (etale-local fs charts); pointed lift: Stacks Tag 03PR, lemma-geometric-lift-to-cover; restriction stalks: Tags 03PQ and 040R.

proof.text: The chart definition [def-trf-log-regular-pair] gives $M_{Y,\bar y}\simeq P\oplus_{\alpha^{-1}(A^\times)}A^\times$. This pushout is the quotient of the product monoid $P\times A^\times$ by the relations $(ab,u)\sim(a,\alpha(b)u)$ for $b\in\alpha^{-1}(A^\times)$. Thus every element has a representative $(a,u)$: products of representatives combine by $(a,u)(a',u')=(aa',uu')$. For each germ $h_i$ choose such a representative $(a_i,u_i)$; the map to $A$ gives $\operatorname{germ}(h_i)=u_i\alpha(a_i)$. Write $v_i=u_i^{-1}$ as an element of $A$, so $u_iv_i=1$. For $r=0$ these are empty lists.

source.place: Exposé VI 1.1 (chart convention); Proposition 1.9 proof, printed p. 71, h = epsilon a. The representative calculation is the defining commutative-monoid pushout quotient.

proof.text: Apply the finite-elements clause of [lem-trf-finite-monoid-stalk-data-spreading] to the structure sheaf on $Y_{\mathrm{Et}}$, the pointed neighbourhood $(W,\bar w)$, and the $2r$ elements $u_i,v_i$ of $A$. It gives one pointed refinement $W_1\to W$ and regular representatives $e_i,d_i$. On $W_1$ the finitely many pairs $e_id_i,1$ and $h_i|_{W_1},e_i\alpha(a_i)|_{W_1}$ have equal germs. Apply that node's finite-equalities clause once more to obtain a single pointed refinement $V'\to W_1$ where all these equalities hold. Then $d_i|_{V'}$ is an inverse to $e_i|_{V'}$, so set $\varepsilon_i=e_i|_{V'}\in\Gamma(V',\mathcal O_{V'})^\times$. The equations give $h_i|_{V'}=\varepsilon_i\alpha(a_i)$. Restrict $c$ to $V'$; it remains a chart since that node's restriction-stalk identification preserves its stalk pushout at every geometric point. Its monoid is the same fs $P$. Each pointed refinement is a $Y$-morphism of etale $Y$-schemes, hence etale by [lem-weil-pbc-etale-composition-cancellation](3), and (2) makes $V'\to V$ etale, and the pointed refinements preserve the original lift with the same $\Omega$. When $r=0$, take $V'=W$ and omit the two spreading applications.

source.place: Tags 03PQ (lemma-cofinal-etale), 040R (definition-stalk and its following element/equality description); finite simultaneous refinement as in Categories Tag 002W, lemma-directed-commutes.

lean.statement: theorem exists_divisorial_section_chart_factorization {Y U : Scheme.{u}} (j : U ⟶ Y) [IsOpenImmersion j] [IsLocallyNoetherian Y] (hU : DenseRange j) (hlog : IsDivisorialFineSaturatedLogRegularPair Y U j hU) {V : Scheme.{u}} (f : V ⟶ Y) [Etale f] (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (y : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ V) (r : ℕ) (h : Fin r → Γ(V, ⊤)) (hh : ∀ i : Fin r, IsUnit ((pullback.fst f j).appTop (h i))) : ∃ (W : Y.Etale) (g : W.left ⟶ V) (w : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ W.left), Etale g ∧ g ≫ f = W.hom ∧ w ≫ g = y ∧ ∃ hunit : ∀ (Ω' : Type u) [Field Ω'] [IsAlgClosed Ω'] (t : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ Y), IsUnit.submonoid (strictLocalRing Y t) ≤ divisorialStalk j t, ∃ (P : Type u) (_ : CommMonoid P) (c : P →* divisorialSections j W), IsFineSaturatedMonoid P ∧ (∀ (Ω' : Type u) [Field Ω'] [IsAlgClosed Ω'] (t : Spec (.of Ω') ⟶ Y) (z : (Scheme.pointSmallEtale t).fiber.obj W), IsDivisorialStalkChart (divisorialStalk j t) (hunit Ω' t) ((divisorialGerm j t W z).comp c)) ∧ ∃ (a : Fin r → P) (ε : Fin r → Γ(W.left, ⊤)ˣ), ∀ i : Fin r, g.appTop (h i) = (ε i).val * (c (a i)).val
